# Citekind

> Citekind is an AI search visibility (answer engine optimisation) consultancy for B2B cybersecurity and fintech scale-ups in the UK and Europe. It helps companies get found, cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Overviews. It is led by a former cybersecurity CMO.

## Services

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://citekind.com/#audit): a fixed-price audit that tests real buyer prompts across the major AI assistants, benchmarks against competitors and delivers a prioritised 90-day plan.
- [Services](https://citekind.com/#services): answer-ready content programmes and fractional CMO support for B2B tech.
- [Free AI visibility check](https://citekind.com/check/): an instant AI readiness score for any website plus a guided self-test of what AI assistants say.
